examples.english: This road curves sharply along the river, so please slow down.

notes:
Describes a smooth, arc-like curve or bend. Composed of ⟦{湾|わん}→湾：03796_wan⟧ (bay, inlet — suggesting a natural curve) and ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (bend, curve). Used for physical objects, roads, and anatomical features. Also used in optics and engineering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湾曲|わんきょく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: curved, bent
- {湾曲|わんきょく}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: curved section
- {脊柱|せきちゅう}{湾曲|わんきょく}{症|しょう}: spinal curvature disorder (scoliosis/kyphosis)
- {湾曲|わんきょく}⟦ディスプレイ→ディスプレイ：04891_disupurei⟧: curved display

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屈曲|くっきょく}→屈曲：22871_kukkyoku⟧: bending, flexion — sharper, more angular bends
- ⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧: curve (line) — the geometric line itself
- ⟦{歪|ゆが}み→歪み：09409_yugami⟧: distortion, warping — implies deformation from a normal shape
